summary: Anbio Biotechnology filed a Form 6-K attached with a proxy statement and notice for a meeting of Class A ordinary shareholders and an extraordinary general meeting to be held on May 15, 2026. The proposals include increasing authorized share capital from 500M shares to 3 trillion shares across multiple classes, modifying class rights, and increasing Class B voting rights. The filing is routine governance, proposing amendments to the company's articles and capital structure for financing or flexibility. No special-situation transaction—merger, tender offer, or acquisition—is disclosed.
